[Oppenheimer](/wiki/Oppenheimer_(film)) is a 2023 [epic](/wiki/Epic_film) [biographical](/wiki/Biographical_film) [thriller film](/wiki/Thriller_film)[[a]](#cite_note-5) written and directed by [Christopher Nolan](/wiki/Christopher_Nolan), who co-produced it with [Emma Thomas](/wiki/Emma_Thomas) and [Charles Roven](/wiki/Charles_Roven).[[4]](#cite_note-6) Based on the 2005 biography [American Prometheus](/wiki/American_Prometheus) by [Kai Bird](/wiki/Kai_Bird) and [Martin J. Sherwin](/wiki/Martin_J._Sherwin), it chronicles the career of American theoretical physicist [J. Robert Oppenheimer](/wiki/J._Robert_Oppenheimer), from his studies to his direction of the [Los Alamos Laboratory](/wiki/Project_Y), during [World War II](/wiki/World_War_II), and the [1954 security hearing](/wiki/Oppenheimer_security_clearance_hearing) that resulted in his political fall from grace.[[5]](#cite_note-7) The film stars [Cillian Murphy](/wiki/Cillian_Murphy) as the titular character with an [ensemble supporting cast](/wiki/Ensemble_cast) including [Emily Blunt](/wiki/Emily_Blunt), [Matt Damon](/wiki/Matt_Damon), [Robert Downey Jr.](/wiki/Robert_Downey_Jr.), [Florence Pugh](/wiki/Florence_Pugh), [Josh Hartnett](/wiki/Josh_Hartnett), [Casey Affleck](/wiki/Casey_Affleck), [Rami Malek](/wiki/Rami_Malek), and [Kenneth Branagh](/wiki/Kenneth_Branagh).[[6]](#cite_note-8)

Oppenheimer had its world premiere at [Le Grand Rex](/wiki/Le_Grand_Rex) in [Paris](/wiki/Paris) on July 11, 2023,[[7]](#cite_note-9) followed by the British premiere at [Odeon Luxe Leicester Square](/wiki/Odeon_Luxe_Leicester_Square) in [London](/wiki/London) on July 13,[[8]](#cite_note-10) and the American premiere at AMC [Lincoln Square](/wiki/Lincoln_Square,_Manhattan) 13 in [New York City](/wiki/New_York_City) on July 17.[[9]](#cite_note-11) The film was released theatrically in the United States, the United Kingdom, and most other countries on July 21 by [Universal Pictures](/wiki/Universal_Pictures).[[10]](#cite_note-12) Its concurrent release with [Warner Bros](/wiki/Warner_Bros)'s [Barbie](/wiki/Barbie_(film)) was the catalyst for the "[Barbenheimer](/wiki/Barbenheimer)" phenomenon, encouraging audiences to see both films as a [double feature](/wiki/Double_feature).[[11]](#cite_note-13) In [Japan](/wiki/Japan), the film did not get released until March 29, 2024, after getting picked up by Japanese distributor Bitters End in December 2023.[[b]](#cite_note-19)[[13]](#cite_note-JapanOpening-15) Produced on a budget of $100 million,[[17]](#cite_note-HighestGrossingWWII-20) Oppenheimer grossed $975 million worldwide,[[18]](#cite_note-BOM-21) going on to become the [third-highest-grossing film of 2023](/wiki/2023_in_film),[[19]](#cite_note-BOM2023-22) the highest-grossing biographical film of all time,[[20]](#cite_note-23) the highest-grossing World War II-related film of all time,[[17]](#cite_note-HighestGrossingWWII-20) and the then [second-highest-grossing R-rated film](/wiki/List_of_highest-grossing_R-rated_films) of all time, behind [Joker](/wiki/Joker_(2019_film)).[[21]](#cite_note-24) Oppenheimer received widespread critical acclaim,[[c]](#cite_note-28) with particular praise for its screenplay, performances and production values.[[d]](#cite_note-34) On the [review aggregator](/wiki/Review_aggregator) website [Rotten Tomatoes](/wiki/Rotten_Tomatoes), the film holds an approval rating of 93% based on 513 reviews,[[30]](#cite_note-35) making it the platform's best-reviewed movie of 2023.[[31]](#cite_note-36)

Oppenheimer garnered awards and nominations from a wide assortment of categories, with recognition for its direction, screenplay, performances (particularly those of Murphy and Downey Jr.), [Ludwig Göransson](/wiki/Ludwig_G%C3%B6ransson)'s musical score, [Hoyte van Hoytema](/wiki/Hoyte_van_Hoytema)'s cinematography, and [Jennifer Lame](/wiki/Jennifer_Lame)'s editing. At the [96th Academy Awards](/wiki/96th_Academy_Awards), the film received thirteen nominations, surpassing eight nominations each received by [The Dark Knight](/wiki/The_Dark_Knight), [Inception](/wiki/Inception), and [Dunkirk](/wiki/Dunkirk_(2017_film)) to become Nolan's most Oscar-nominated film,[[32]](#cite_note-37) winning seven: [Best Picture](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Picture), [Best Director](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Director) (Nolan), [Best Actor](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Actor) (Murphy), [Best Supporting Actor](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor) (Downey Jr.), [Best Film Editing](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Film_Editing), [Best Cinematography](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Cinematography), and [Best Original Score](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Original_Score). Oppenheimer received another thirteen nominations at the [29th Critics' Choice Awards](/wiki/29th_Critics%27_Choice_Awards), winning eight, including [Best Director](/wiki/Critics%27_Choice_Movie_Award_for_Best_Director) (Nolan), [Best Supporting Actor](/wiki/Critics%27_Choice_Movie_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor) (Downey Jr.), and [Best Score](/wiki/Critics%27_Choice_Movie_Award_for_Best_Score). The film won seven awards from thirteen nominations at the [77th British Academy Film Awards](/wiki/77th_British_Academy_Film_Awards), including [Best Film](/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Film) and [Best Direction](/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Direction) (Nolan). With his win for [Best Actor](/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Actor_in_a_Leading_Role), Murphy became the [first Irish-born performer to receive an Oscar](/wiki/List_of_Academy_Award_winners_and_nominees_from_Ireland#Best_Actor_in_a_Leading_Role) and a BAFTA in a leading category.[[33]](#cite_note-38)[[34]](#cite_note-39) The film received eight nominations at the [81st Golden Globe Awards](/wiki/81st_Golden_Globe_Awards), winning [Best Motion Picture – Drama](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Motion_Picture_%E2%80%93_Drama), [Best Director](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Director) (Nolan), [Best Actor in a Motion Picture – Drama](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Actor_in_a_Motion_Picture_%E2%80%93_Drama) (Murphy), [Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor_%E2%80%93_Motion_Picture) (Downey Jr.) and [Best Original Score](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Original_Score). Both the [National Board of Review](/wiki/National_Board_of_Review) and the [American Film Institute](/wiki/American_Film_Institute) named Oppenheimer one of the Top Ten Films of 2023.

[Oppenheimer](/wiki/Oppenheimer_(film)) is a 2023 [epic](/wiki/Epic_film) [biographical](/wiki/Biographical_film) [thriller film](/wiki/Thriller_film)[[a]](#cite_note-5) written and directed by [Christopher Nolan](/wiki/Christopher_Nolan), who co-produced it with [Emma Thomas](/wiki/Emma_Thomas) and [Charles Roven](/wiki/Charles_Roven).[[4]](#cite_note-6) Based on the 2005 biography [American Prometheus](/wiki/American_Prometheus) by [Kai Bird](/wiki/Kai_Bird) and [Martin J. Sherwin](/wiki/Martin_J._Sherwin), it chronicles the career of American theoretical physicist [J. Robert Oppenheimer](/wiki/J._Robert_Oppenheimer), from his studies to his direction of the [Los Alamos Laboratory](/wiki/Project_Y), during [World War II](/wiki/World_War_II), and the [1954 security hearing](/wiki/Oppenheimer_security_clearance_hearing) that resulted in his political fall from grace.[[5]](#cite_note-7) The film stars [Cillian Murphy](/wiki/Cillian_Murphy) as the titular character with an [ensemble supporting cast](/wiki/Ensemble_cast) including [Emily Blunt](/wiki/Emily_Blunt), [Matt Damon](/wiki/Matt_Damon), [Robert Downey Jr.](/wiki/Robert_Downey_Jr.), [Florence Pugh](/wiki/Florence_Pugh), [Josh Hartnett](/wiki/Josh_Hartnett), [Casey Affleck](/wiki/Casey_Affleck), [Rami Malek](/wiki/Rami_Malek), and [Kenneth Branagh](/wiki/Kenneth_Branagh).[[6]](#cite_note-8)

Oppenheimer had its world premiere at [Le Grand Rex](/wiki/Le_Grand_Rex) in [Paris](/wiki/Paris) on July 11, 2023,[[7]](#cite_note-9) followed by the British premiere at [Odeon Luxe Leicester Square](/wiki/Odeon_Luxe_Leicester_Square) in [London](/wiki/London) on July 13,[[8]](#cite_note-10) and the American premiere at AMC [Lincoln Square](/wiki/Lincoln_Square,_Manhattan) 13 in [New York City](/wiki/New_York_City) on July 17.[[9]](#cite_note-11) The film was released theatrically in the United States, the United Kingdom, and most other countries on July 21 by [Universal Pictures](/wiki/Universal_Pictures).[[10]](#cite_note-12) Its concurrent release with [Warner Bros](/wiki/Warner_Bros)'s [Barbie](/wiki/Barbie_(film)) was the catalyst for the "[Barbenheimer](/wiki/Barbenheimer)" phenomenon, encouraging audiences to see both films as a [double feature](/wiki/Double_feature).[[11]](#cite_note-13) In [Japan](/wiki/Japan), the film did not get released until March 29, 2024, after getting picked up by Japanese distributor Bitters End in December 2023.[[b]](#cite_note-19)[[13]](#cite_note-JapanOpening-15) Produced on a budget of $100 million,[[17]](#cite_note-HighestGrossingWWII-20) Oppenheimer grossed $975 million worldwide,[[18]](#cite_note-BOM-21) going on to become the [third-highest-grossing film of 2023](/wiki/2023_in_film),[[19]](#cite_note-BOM2023-22) the highest-grossing biographical film of all time,[[20]](#cite_note-23) the highest-grossing World War II-related film of all time,[[17]](#cite_note-HighestGrossingWWII-20) and the then [second-highest-grossing R-rated film](/wiki/List_of_highest-grossing_R-rated_films) of all time, behind [Joker](/wiki/Joker_(2019_film)).[[21]](#cite_note-24) Oppenheimer received widespread critical acclaim,[[c]](#cite_note-28) with particular praise for its screenplay, performances and production values.[[d]](#cite_note-34) On the [review aggregator](/wiki/Review_aggregator) website [Rotten Tomatoes](/wiki/Rotten_Tomatoes), the film holds an approval rating of 93% based on 513 reviews,[[30]](#cite_note-35) making it the platform's best-reviewed movie of 2023.[[31]](#cite_note-36)

Oppenheimer garnered awards and nominations from a wide assortment of categories, with recognition for its direction, screenplay, performances (particularly those of Murphy and Downey Jr.), [Ludwig Göransson](/wiki/Ludwig_G%C3%B6ransson)'s musical score, [Hoyte van Hoytema](/wiki/Hoyte_van_Hoytema)'s cinematography, and [Jennifer Lame](/wiki/Jennifer_Lame)'s editing. At the [96th Academy Awards](/wiki/96th_Academy_Awards), the film received thirteen nominations, surpassing eight nominations each received by [The Dark Knight](/wiki/The_Dark_Knight), [Inception](/wiki/Inception), and [Dunkirk](/wiki/Dunkirk_(2017_film)) to become Nolan's most Oscar-nominated film,[[32]](#cite_note-37) winning seven: [Best Picture](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Picture), [Best Director](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Director) (Nolan), [Best Actor](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Actor) (Murphy), [Best Supporting Actor](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor) (Downey Jr.), [Best Film Editing](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Film_Editing), [Best Cinematography](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Cinematography), and [Best Original Score](/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Original_Score). Oppenheimer received another thirteen nominations at the [29th Critics' Choice Awards](/wiki/29th_Critics%27_Choice_Awards), winning eight, including [Best Director](/wiki/Critics%27_Choice_Movie_Award_for_Best_Director) (Nolan), [Best Supporting Actor](/wiki/Critics%27_Choice_Movie_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor) (Downey Jr.), and [Best Score](/wiki/Critics%27_Choice_Movie_Award_for_Best_Score). The film won seven awards from thirteen nominations at the [77th British Academy Film Awards](/wiki/77th_British_Academy_Film_Awards), including [Best Film](/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Film) and [Best Direction](/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Direction) (Nolan). With his win for [Best Actor](/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Actor_in_a_Leading_Role), Murphy became the [first Irish-born performer to receive an Oscar](/wiki/List_of_Academy_Award_winners_and_nominees_from_Ireland#Best_Actor_in_a_Leading_Role) and a BAFTA in a leading category.[[33]](#cite_note-38)[[34]](#cite_note-39) The film received eight nominations at the [81st Golden Globe Awards](/wiki/81st_Golden_Globe_Awards), winning [Best Motion Picture – Drama](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Motion_Picture_%E2%80%93_Drama), [Best Director](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Director) (Nolan), [Best Actor in a Motion Picture – Drama](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Actor_in_a_Motion_Picture_%E2%80%93_Drama) (Murphy), [Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor_%E2%80%93_Motion_Picture) (Downey Jr.) and [Best Original Score](/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Original_Score). Both the [National Board of Review](/wiki/National_Board_of_Review) and the [American Film Institute](/wiki/American_Film_Institute) named Oppenheimer one of the Top Ten Films of 2023.
